title: What Does the Elvis Operator Do?
instructions: What does the `?:` (Elvis) operator do in Kotlin?

options.text: It throws an exception if the value is null
It converts a nullable type to a non-nullable type
It provides a default value when the left side is null
It checks if two values are equal

explanation: The Elvis operator `?:` provides a default value when the expression on the left side is null. For example, `name ?: "Unknown"` returns the name if it is not null, or "Unknown" if it is null.
